input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

This isn't actually in the CSV writer — the merging happens earlier, during ingest dedup. `dedupeKey` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` builds its key from `date`, `amount`, and `description` only, so two transactions that differ solely by `currency` (e.g. same date/amount/description, one EUR and one USD) hash to the same key and one is dropped as a duplicate. This matches the report: it only started happening once transactions began carrying a currency field (3.2.0). Fix should include `t.currency` in the `dedupeKey` join so same-looking transactions in different currencies are treated as distinct.

input.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
input.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount, and description only, so two transactions that differ solely by currency (e.g. the same amount in EUR and USD) collide and one is dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer treated as the same row.
